5.q: The spread (difference) between free air temperature and dew point temperature is … when air is saturated

6.q: The saturation vapour pressure over water is … than over ice

7.q: As the temperature of the air increases, the amount of water vapour required to saturate it …

9.q: Humidity mixing ratio … when air is lifted adiabatically

ex.3: In saturated air (fog, rain) dry bulb = wet bulb = dew point.
ex.4: Humid air is less dense, so take-off run is longer (the book suggests adding 10% to take-off distance in high humidity).
ex.6: At sub-zero temperatures SVP over water is greater than over ice, so in mixed clouds drops evaporate and ice crystals grow (Bergeron process).
ex.9: With no water added or removed, the mixing ratio (g of WV per kg of dry air) stays constant during adiabatic lifting.
